summary: Completed full E2E testing of NEW FlowDesk in-app notification system. Backend: 10/10 dedicated notification pytest cases pass + 17/17 prior regression tests still pass (total 27/27 = 100%). Frontend: bell, dropdown, mark-all-read, conversation/lead/task navigation, dashboard 'Requires Attention' section, simulate-inbound -> bell increment, handoff dedup all verified via Playwright with admin session cookie. No critical or blocking issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: Dedup logic in _make_notification uses (type, related_entity_id, assigned_user_id, is_read:false) which correctly prevents duplicate unread notifs but allows new ones after the prior is marked read — verified by multiple dashboard hits not duplicating overdue_task notifs.

Dashboard generates task notifications inside GET /dashboard/metrics — works but means consumers must hit dashboard to surface task notifs. Acceptable for MVP given the dashboard is the landing route.
backfill_notifications() runs on startup and on /admin/reseed — good, ensures demo state has handoff_required notifs without requiring a UI action.
NotificationBell polls every 20s via React Query refetchInterval — reasonable; consider websocket for production scale.
Notifications use UUID 'id' and exclude Mongo _id in find queries (projection {_id:0}) — clean serialization.
Server.py is now 1066 lines; recommend splitting into routers/notifications.py, routers/conversations.py, routers/ai.py once it crosses 1200 lines.
test_credentials: [ELIMINADAS] Las credenciales predecibles de la prueba histórica deben considerarse revocadas.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Tests mutate notification read state (mark-all-read) and simulate inbound on unassigned demo conv (Elena Rossi / Marcus Webb), which is reversible by re-running /admin/reseed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend notification tests at /app/backend/tests/test_notifications.py — run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_notifications.py -v. Key data-testids: notification-bell, notification-unread-count, notification-dropdown, notification-item-{id}, mark-all-read, requires-attention, attn-handoffs, attn-unread, attn-overdue, attn-handoff-{convId}, attn-unread-{convId}, attn-overdue-{taskId}, simulate-inbound-button, bot-toggle. Demo unassigned conv ids include Elena Rossi (idx 4, unread) and Marcus Webb (idx 5, bot disabled). Dashboard GET /api/dashboard/metrics is what materializes task notifications — call it before asserting overdue_task / task_due_soon notifs.
rca of the issue: No issues. All 11 testing items from the review request were verified end-to-end. Specifically: (1) GET /notifications returns 7+ notifs for admin including handoff_required + overdue_task + new_message; (2) GET /notifications/unread-count matches len(list?unread_only=true); (3) PATCH /{id}/read sets is_read=true, read_at non-null, decrements count by 1; (4) POST /read-all sets count to 0; (5) simulate-inbound on unassigned Elena/Marcus increments conversation.unread by 1 and creates a new_message notif for admin (fallback); (6) PATCH bot_enabled=false creates a handoff_required notif idempotently (3 toggles -> 1 unread); (7) GET /dashboard/metrics returns requires_attention with open_handoffs/unread_conversations/overdue_tasks lists; (8) hitting dashboard 3x does NOT duplicate task notifs; (9-11) frontend bell badge, dropdown, navigation, mark-all-read, dashboard attention cards and inbox simulate-inbound + bot toggle all verified in browser.
